page.title: People
page.intro: The people who sign in here and whether their synchronization works. You see their email, role, sign-ins, and sync status, never their calendars, connected account emails, or events.

actions.label: Actions for {email}
actions.changePlanHint: Choose which plan limits this person.
actions.makeAdministratorHint: They can manage people, storage, and who can join. They still never see anyone else's calendars.
actions.removeAdministratorHint: They keep their own calendars and rules.
actions.disableHint: They cannot sign in, and their rules wait until you enable them again.
actions.enableHint: They can sign in again, and their rules resume.
actions.passwordResetHint: A link they use once to choose a new password.
actions.deleteHint: Deletes their sign-in, rules, and calendar connections, and the events their rules wrote. Their calendar accounts and their own events stay.

status.disabled: {email} can no longer sign in. Their rules wait until you enable them again.

deletedEvents.one: {count} event their rules wrote was deleted.
deletedEvents.other: {count} events their rules wrote were deleted.

left.one: {count} rule could not reach its calendar, so its events stay there, no longer managed.
left.other: {count} rules could not reach their calendars, so their events stay there, no longer managed.

delete.title: Delete {email} permanently?
delete.body: This deletes their sign-in, rules, calendar connections, tokens, and Activity. The events their rules wrote are deleted from their calendars wherever Calendar Ghost can still reach them. Their own events and their calendar accounts stay as they are. Backups taken before now keep their records until they rotate out. This cannot be undone.

reset.title: Copy the password reset link for {email} now
reset.body: Send it to them yourself. It works once, until {expires}, and is shown only once. You never see or set their password.
reset.label: Password reset link for {email}

invitations.title: Invitations waiting
invitations.body: Each link works once, for 7 days. Send it to the person yourself; they choose their own email and password.

reveal.title: Copy the invitation link now
reveal.body: Send it to the person you invite. It works once, until {expires}, and is shown only once.
reveal.label: Invitation link

invitations.revoked: The invitation was revoked. Its link no longer works.

empty.title: No invitations are waiting
empty.body: Invite someone to create a link they can use once to join.

verdict.stalled: Calendar Ghost has not checked calendars recently, so nothing synchronizes until the service runs again.

verdict.waiting: A calendar provider is limiting or failing requests. Calendar Ghost retries by itself.
verdict.paused: Rules exist, but none is running.
verdict.healthy: Every rule is running and up to date.
